text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Persimpangan Bertingkat Bandar Serenia) 2018.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 26 November 2018.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Persimpangan Bertingkat Bandar

Serenia yang merupakan sebahagian daripada Lebuh Raya Utara Selatan Hubungan

Tengah yang bermula dari kilometer 33.867 di koordinat S -91961.110, T 19163.182

Grid Bentuk Benar Serong di Tepi (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir

di kilometer 36.041 di koordinat S -92736.873, T 21145.679 Grid RSO Geosentrik

(GDM 2000) Lebuh Raya Utara Selatan Hubungan Tengah, kedua-dua jarak diukur dari

kilometer 0.0 Lebuh Raya Utara Selatan Hubungan Tengah di Persimpangan Bertingkat

Johor Bahru termasuk Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Bandar Serenia dan jalan-jalan

sambungannya dan berakhir di Had Sempadan Penyenggaraan (HSP)

di koordinat S -91764.525, T 20812.704 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000),

diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (BANDAR SERENIA INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads

(Bandar Serenia Interchange) Order 2018.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 26 November 2018.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the Bandar Serenia Interchange which is

part of the North South Expressway Central Link commencing from kilometre 33.867 at

coordinates S -91961.110, E 19163.182 of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO)

Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 36.041 at

coordinates S -92736.873, E 21145.679 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid of the

North South Expressway Central Link, both distances are measured from kilometre 0.0

of the North South Expressway Central Link at the Johore Bahru Interchange including

the Bandar Serenia Entry/Exit Toll Plaza and its link roads and ending at the

Limit of Maintenance Responsibility (LMR) at coordinates S -91764.525, E 20812.704

of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid, is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.
